title: Quadratic Composed with a Linear Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Let $f(x)=x^{2}$ and $g(x)=2x+1$. Find a formula for the composite $(f\circ g)(x)$ and write the result as an expanded polynomial.

steps.title: Unfold the Definition of Composition
steps.explanation: The composite $f\circ g$ means the linear function $g$ runs first, and the squaring function $f$ is applied to its output.
steps.why: Composition is always evaluated from the inside function outward.

steps.title: Square the Binomial
steps.explanation: Apply the identity $(a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2$ with $a=2x$ and $b=1$.
steps.why: Expanding the perfect square converts the composed formula into standard polynomial form.

steps.title: Collect Terms for the Final Formula
steps.explanation: Carrying out each product gives $4x^2$, $4x$, and $1$, so $(f\circ g)(x)=4x^2+4x+1$ for every real $x$.
steps.why: No domain restrictions arise because both $f$ and $g$ are defined on all of $\mathbb{R}$.
